outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of US and MRI markers for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
Correlation of US and MRI findings with FIGO grading and severity of PAS
cohort: 39 pregnant patients with at least one previous cesarean delivery and placenta previa
finding: While no single ultrasonographic or magnetic resonance imaging finding alone can predict placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) with high sensitivity and specificity, the presence of three or more imaging signs significantly increases the diagnostic accuracy for PAS.
